A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PhaSR, with matching main sections and supplementary material. Their text, equations, tables and figures support comparison, including matching retained content across figure renumbering and relocation.

before.justification: v1 reports original PhaSR benchmark results, component ablations, efficiency measurements and cross-dataset generalization experiments in Tables 1–7.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments, revises several reported values and adds an image-editor comparison in supplementary Figure 11.

M1.justification: PAN, GSRA, the encoder-decoder architecture, prior extraction and training losses are unchanged. Section 3, supplementary Algorithm 1 and the architecture specification in Table 8 describe the same procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain ISTD, ISTD+, INS, WSRD+, Ambient6K and the additional PAN evaluations on SRD and CL3AN. The new editor comparison uses two selected Ambient6K images, without adding a dataset, domain or task.

E2.justification: Supplementary Section 9 and new Figure 11 add Qwen-image-edit and Nano Banana as evaluated comparators. The comparator sets in the existing benchmark, preprocessing, ablation and cross-dataset comparisons remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The added editor comparison introduces a two-image evaluation using the prompt "Remove shadows from the image" and reports fidelity and inference time. Existing training settings and benchmark protocols are unchanged; the revised WSRD+ values do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The PAN/GSRA ablation configurations, cross-dataset tests, feature-map analyses and dark-material/specular-surface failure study are retained. Existing ablation scores change, but no new component, sensitivity or robustness analysis is introduced; the new editor panel supplies additional baseline comparisons.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, variability estimates or statistical significance tests. The new comparison's use of "significantly" is not accompanied by statistical testing.

E6.justification: WSRD+ revisions materially reduce the reported advantage: Table 1 changes PhaSR SSIM from 0.942 to 0.842, narrowing its lead over DenseSR's unchanged 0.838 from 0.104 to 0.004. Tables 3, 5 and 6 also revise WSRD+ SSIM values; Table 5 changes PAN RMSE from 0.9418 to 0.9452. PSNR values remain unchanged. New Figure 11 reports PhaSR at 29.41 dB/0.2 seconds, Qwen-image-edit at 15.43 dB/25 minutes and Nano Banana at 16.86 dB/30 seconds for the two-image comparison.

T1.justification: The Retinex formulation, normalization equations, differential-attention construction, losses and supplementary depth-to-normal mathematics are unchanged. Neither version adds formal results or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements and conclusion retain the same claims about dual-level physical alignment, PAN's benefits, GSRA and efficient generalization to ambient lighting. The new editor comparison does not revise these core contribution statements.

C2.justification: Supplementary Section 9 newly attributes the editors' lower fidelity to lacking task-specific physical priors and contrasts this with PhaSR's alignment mechanism. Existing interpretations and limitations concerning dark materials, specular surfaces and non-Lambertian effects remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v4 discloses the prompt used for the new editor comparison. PhaSR's implementation details, preprocessing, training hyperparameters, architecture specification and code-access statement are retained. Exact editor versions and hardware for the new timing comparison are not supplied.

R1.justification: The new supplementary discussion extends positioning to general-purpose image editors, arguing for task-specific physical priors. Section 2's research positioning otherwise remains stable. Most bibliography edits abbreviate venues or consolidate duplicate entries, rather than introduce additional research.

P1.justification: v4 adds a short editor-comparison discussion, changes the author name from Jing-Hui Jung to Jin-Hui Jiang, fixes heading punctuation and condenses bibliography formatting. The main narrative and section organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: v4 adds the two-row editor comparison as Figure 11, relocates the retained failure-case panel and renumbers former Figures 11–16 as Figures 12–17. Supplementary text and references consequently reflow; existing table structures and most visual material are retained.

improvement.justification: The added editor comparison provides limited new evidence, but two selected images and unspecified model versions and timing hardware do not support its broad explanation about missing physical priors. The substantial WSRD+ numerical revisions are unexplained, so the PDFs do not establish whether they improve reporting accuracy. These mixed effects prevent a reliable judgment of net paper-quality improvement.
